The Architecture of Sound

On the geometry of listening and the physical spaces of acoustics.

Music · 9 min read · Placeholder copy

A room is the first instrument. Before a needle touches vinyl, the walls, floor, and furniture have already decided how the record will sound. The story starts with the space around the system, not the gear inside it.

About

The host

I’m a city boy from Cali; L.A. is where I reside.

Substance With Style™ is hosted by Luke Hardeman (aka Forrestt Runn), a writer, photographer and general weirdo.

He loves standup comedy and sometimes sings in a band.

Luke Hardeman (sometimes operating under the alias Forrestt Runn) is a digital media producer, certified specialty coffee barista, and cultural archivist. Raised on a steady diet of 90s VHS tapes, late-night cable, and Los Angeles public transit, he has spent his life reverse-engineering the media and environments around him.

Substance With Style™ is his public operating system.

The long way here

A short timeline

  1. 1998–1999On-air gig at KDIS AM 710 (Radio Disney).
  2. 2001–2005Theater nerd and wannabe documentarian at St. Bernard Catholic High School in Playa Del Rey, CA.
  3. 2005–2006The Posse Foundation sent me to Dickinson College. More theater, another radio gig (WDCV), and dropping out after one semester.
  4. 2007–2009A wild period in the wilderness of my early 20s. Barack Obama brought hope and change, and I learned what student loan interest rates meant.
  5. 2009–2011Created Your Proof It Happened, a nightlife photoblog, and wrote for Chicks With Guns Magazine, all under a pseudonym: Markus Eliance.
  6. 2012–2016Finishing undergrad and creating Forrestt Runn / Group Hug at CSU Channel Islands.
  7. 2016–2024Odd jobs, with music and comedy writing in between. Explored culinary arts, barista training and latte art, cannabis cultivation, bartending, hospitality, and experimenting with GitHub and app development.
  8. 2026Substance With Style™ soft-launched.
